t: My house is full of adders!

o: ¡Al lavarme había tres enroscadas en la palangana!
t: When I washed, there were three coiled up in the basin!

o: ¡En el forro del saco había muchas!
t: There were many in the lining of the sack!
And there are more! There are other things!

o: ¡Mi mujer me ha llenado la casa de víboras!
t: My wife has filled the house with adders!

o: ¡Ha traído enormes arañas peludas que me persiguen!
t: She brought huge hairy spiders that chase me!

o: ¡Ahora comprendo por qué me espiaba día y noche!
t: Now I understand why she spied on me day and night!
He wanted to leave because of that!
